content.title: Municipal Court
content.summary: The Arvada Municipal Court addresses traffic infractions, criminal citations, municipal code violations, and parking citations within the City of Arvada. While most citations are handled by this court, some may be processed by Jefferson or Adams County Courts. The court offers record checks, virtual hearings, and online payment options, and encourages individuals to contact them for assistance or information regarding their citations.
content.body:
The Arvada Municipal Court handles traffic infractions and criminal citations, as well as municipal code violations and parking citations that are issued in the City of Arvada.

Remember that even if a citation is written within the City of Arvada, it may be handled by [Jefferson County Courts](https://www.jeffco.us/courts) or [Adams County Courts](https://www.courts.state.co.us/Courts/County/Index.cfm?County_ID=55).

The Arvada Municipal Court can provide record checks for citations that have been written in the City.

If you cannot find the information you are seeking within these pages, please do not hesitate to call the Arvada Municipal Court at 720-898-7150. We will be happy to help you. If you are calling about a citation/ticket, please have your citation/ticket number available before you call.

**Our Mission**: Provide individuals a fair and impartial judicial process in a timely and efficient manner.

## Presiding Judge Orders

- [Order Limiting the Maximum Sentence](/1462)
- [Virtual Court Decorum Order](/1324/Virtual-Court-Decorum-Order)
- [Order Prohibiting Photography / Recording in the Courthouse](/1316/Order-Prohibiting-Photography-Recording-)

## Online Services

### [Request a Virtual Hearing](/1324/Virtual-Court-Decorum-Order)

### Payments

Pay your [Penalty Assessment ticket or make your Payment Plan installments online.](https://mobile.citepayusa.com/?agency=ArvadaMuni) If you wish to pay by mail, send your payment to:

Arvada Municipal Court  
8101 Ralston Road  
Arvada, CO 80002

## Livestream Court

### Warning

Do not record, reproduce, or publish any court proceedings.  Any recording, reproduction, or publishing of a proceeding without the express prior authorization of the court is prohibited and may subject you to contempt proceedings, which may include a fine, jail, or both.  Recordings, reproductions, and publications include any audio recordings, visual recording, screen capture, photograph, or other similar media.  Please see [Chief Justice Directive 23-02](https://www.coloradojudicial.gov/media/15571) and [C.R.S. § 13-1-132](https://leg.colorado.gov/sites/default/files/images/olls/crs2024-title-13.pdf) for more information.

### Witnesses who are set to testify

If the court issues a sequestration order that prohibits you from watching these proceedings, disconnect immediately and let the court know if you watched or heard any of the proceedings.

### Parties to the proceeding who are appearing virtually for court

Please note that you will not be able to participate from this site. Contact the court for the appropriate link that allows you to participate virtually.

### Accessibility

In the event you are unable to access the video court sessions or you need an accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), please contact the Arvada Municipal Court at 720-898-7150 or [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#95f4e7e3f4f1f4f8e0fbfcf6fce5f4f9d5f4e7e3f4f1f4bbfae7f2).  For more information, see also [Arvada's Accessibility Webpage](/842).

### Available Livestreams

**Monday through Friday 8:30 am - 4:30 pm**

- [Courtroom 1 Livestream](https://stream.lifesizecloud.com/extension/835235/011ade66-88f9-49c5-a250-898bb9ad74e4)
- [Courtroom 2 Livestream](https://stream.lifesizecloud.com/extension/835236/05d33352-3d30-47e8-acde-ae5c90a55843)
- [Arvada - JeffCo Arraignments Livestream](https://stream.lifesizecloud.com/extension/835241/9536f661-8a7b-41c7-9556-e1d854fb2480)
- Virtual Hearings 11:00 a.m. on the following days:
  - [First Tuesday of the Month Livestream](https://arvadaco-gov.zoom.us/j/81631215578?pwd=4N3xL0VEFcNY6xlgtx1wlDohYVNA6G.1)
  - [Third Tuesday of the Month Livestream](https://arvadaco-gov.zoom.us/j/86755145619?pwd=7NgRpxXko21FSXraF57xvaFvgZYKTK.1)

For more information, please contact the court at: 720-898-7150

## Submitting Court-Ordered Documentation

If you have been ordered to complete Community Service, a class, treatment, therapy, etc., please [send your documents via email](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#5435262235303539213a3d373d243538143526223530357a3b2633) or [by mail](/Directory.aspx?DID=50).

## To Request Discovery

The [discovery request form](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/32712) can be submitted online and is also available from the Court. The form must be completed and given to the Clerk of Court with the appropriate fee. Fees for discovery, payable by cash, check, or credit card, are $10 for ordinance violations and $2 for traffic violations. Discovery is provided by the City Attorney's Office by email, pickup or U.S. Mail. It may take up to 7 days to receive your discovery. If you have any questions, please contact the City Attorney's Office at 720-898-7180.

### [FAQs](/Faq.aspx?TID=73)

[What are the Community Service Requirements?](#)
:   Unless specified in writing by the Judge, all community service must be completed at a Non-Profit (501)(c)(3) organization. There are many organizations that will benefit from your service. To find an organization, browse one of these websites:

    - [Just Serve](http://www.justserve.org/)
    - [Volunteers of America (Colorado Branch)](https://www.voacolorado.org/)

[How do I reschedule my hearing or ask for a continuance?](#)
:   To request a continuance or to reschedule any hearing scheduled by the court:

    - The Defendant must make the request in person, at the court
    - If the Defendant is a juvenile, a parent / guardian must be present
    - All requests require signed paperwork indicating knowledge and acceptance of the new court date

    For a description of court hearing types, please see the [Court Hearing Types page](/389/Court-Hearing-Types).

[Does the City of Arvada have a curfew?](#)
:   The City of Arvada's curfew ordinance for juveniles can be found in the [Arvada Municipal Code at 62-151 through 154](https://www.municode.com/library/co/arvada/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=PTIICOOR_CH62OF_ARTVCU). Anyone under 18 years of age is prohibited from being in a public place after 10 pm on Sunday through Thursday nights, and after midnight on Friday and Saturday nights. The curfew is in effect until 6 am the following morning.

    The exceptions are:

    - Accompanied by a parent or someone over 21 who has legal custody of the juvenile
    - Going to, or returning directly home from, a school activity
    - Returning directly home from lawful employment
    - Attending or returning directly from an activity involving the exercise of first amendment rights of free speech, freedom of assembly or freedom of religion
    - In a motor vehicle with parental consent for normal travel

[Juvenile Cases](#)
:   Anyone under the age of 18 is considered a juvenile, and the following rules apply:

    - All juvenile hearings require a parent or legal guardian to accompany their child to Court.
    - Rescheduling a juvenile hearing can ONLY be conducted in person with both the juvenile and parent or legal guardian present.
    - Information regarding a juvenile case will NOT be provided by telephone. Questions regarding juvenile cases must be requested in person with both the juvenile and parent or legal guardian present.

[Where can I take my court ordered classes?](#)
:   If you have been sentenced to complete a class, you can find information about those classes here.

    ## Institute for Specialized Alternative Education (I.S.A.E.)

    Offers classes including Teens and Tobacco, Petty Theft, Violence is Preventable, Violence Intervention, Discovering Better Choices, Young Offenders, and Female Offenders. Visit [the ISAE website](http://www.isaeonline.com/) for more information.

    ## CIMA Remote Education

    Offers classes including Responsible Driver, Aggressive Driver, Road Rage, Petty Theft, Resolving Conflict, Anger Management, and Animal Management. Visit [the CIMA website](https://www.cimaeducation.com/) for more information.

    ## National Institute for Change

    Offers Youth and Adult therapeutic services and one-day classes. Visit [the National Institute for Change website](http://www.nichange.com/) for more information.

[Can I bring coffee or other drinks to court?](#)
:   Food and drinks (this includes water) are not allowed in the courtroom. Items may not be stored in a purse, briefcase, backpack, etc., but must be removed from the courtroom, even if in a sealed or unopened container.
